dec.ct: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
dec.pe: Rwanda expelled Burundian refugees as a group because of their nationality. The African Commission said each person must be considered individually.
dec.pi: Rwanda mengusir pengungsi Burundi secara berkelompok karena kewarganegaraannya. Komisi Afrika menyatakan setiap orang harus dipertimbangkan satu per satu.
